summary: Cap tool output by the served window
description: FR-C2-03. The trim cap is the smaller of the absolute cap and 10 percent of the served context window. decide uses that cap only when usage includes context_window. Without context_window, the absolute cap from CTX-003 stays in force.
scope: decide trims a 1001-token tool on the short window
acceptanceCriteria: effective_tool_cap(4000, 10000) is 1000. effective_tool_cap(4000, 100000) is 4000. decide with context_window 10000 and a tool token_count 1001 returns action trim and reason tool_output_over_cap. A call with no context_window and token_count 4000 still returns none. FR-C2-03.
constraints: Do not trim token_count 4000 when context_window is absent.
Do not change the CTX-003 marker or the head and tail lengths.
Do not apply the window share to the system message or the latest user message.
